name: quiz-history-middle-adventure
reviewNotes: All 176 original ROM-glyph records visually reviewed: 44 questions and three choices each. Preserve option order, numeric alternatives, source line breaks and dynamic hero references. No answer-key or scoring edits.

Keep Famicom historical questions separate from the current SNES story. Numeric alternatives include 30/45/99 levels and 60000/65535/99999 ryo. Deliberately incorrect choices remain incorrect alternatives rather than being corrected to game facts.

Use released names for exact source-name matches, and existing wording for ice items, Hope Capital shops, the cherry-tree riddle and its poem. Joke city names, old-game treasures and quoted cries remain subject to editorial review; runtime quiz layout and scoring are not yet verified.
